title: Transformers.js: models running in the browser

videos.script: Every model so far ran on somebody's server. This one runs in the page. {{runtime}} Transformers.js is two halves: a library that knows the model's files, and ONNX Runtime, which does the arithmetic. Native in Node, WebAssembly in a browser. {{files}} The model is files. ana's is four of them, under ten kilobytes, trained on thirty of her cases. {{node}} In Node, the same pipeline call as in Python. Seven of ten held-out cases right, in a fifth of a second. {{browser}} In Chromium, nine requests, all to one host. The e-mail never left the machine. The runtime weighed twenty-seven megabytes. The model, five kilobytes.
